PR#66175: the bug is that NDFrame.astype resolves the string to a SparseDtype before dispatch, skipping the NaT->iNaT fill conversion on the Series/DataFrame path; also broken for explicit SparseDtype('int64').
PR#66175 and commit: a fully dense float SparseArray with NaN fill cast to an integer subtype wrongly raised IntCastingNaNError; fix skips conversion when sp_index.npoints == len(self).
